而旦奭伏雍之儔又相與明
勗而篤輔之是以道化融洽
俊民鬻用而卷阿之雅所爲
作也今
主上以冲齡登
大寶與成王無異臣日執經侍
上左右竊伏覩
===
聖德至譔夫其
儲神覽聽則訪落之慕也
經帷不輟御則緝熙之軌也若
扆獨覲九服宴如即成王愧
之矣曾不踰禩而
英聲榮問蜚塞霄淵天下之人
莫不神竦色澤謂
punctuated: 而旦、奭、佚、雍之儔，又相與明勗而篤輔之，是以道化融洽，俊民嚮用，而《卷阿》之雅所爲作也。今主上以冲齡登大寶，與成王無異。臣日執經侍上左右，竊伏覩聖德至熟。夫其儲神覽聽，則《訪落》之摹也；經帷不輟御，則《緝煕》之軌也。若負扆獨覲，九服宴如，即成王愧之矣。曽不踰禩，而英聲榮問，蜚塞霄淵。天下之人，莫不神竦色澤，謂
translation_en: Moreover, peers such as Dan [the Duke of Zhou 周公旦], Shi [the Duke of Shao 召公奭], Yi [Shi Yi 史佚], and Yong [Yong Bo 雍伯] joined together in brightly encouraging and earnestly assisting him. Because of this, moral transformation was harmonious and pervasive, men of outstanding talent turned toward service, and for this reason the ode "Juan'e" (Curving Hill) was composed. Today, His Majesty has ascended the Great Treasure [the throne] at a tender age, no different from King Cheng. Every day, your servant holds the classics in attendance at His Majesty's side, and in humble reverence has observed His sacred virtue most intimately. His concentrating His spirit in reviewing memorials and listening to counsel follows the pattern of "Fangluo" (Taking Counsel at the Beginning); His unceasing attendance at the classical lectures traces the path of "Jixi" (Continuously Bright). As for His standing alone before the screen to give audience while the nine domains remain tranquil and at peace, even King Cheng would feel ashamed before Him. Before even a full year has passed, His heroic reputation and glorious renown have soared to fill heaven and the abyss. Among the people of the realm, there is none whose spirit is not stirred and whose countenance does not beam with joy, saying that…

title: 萬曆元年順天府鄉試錄
text:
聖天子復出挾墳策者流即隱伏
疏逖亦莫不滌志砥行蘄自
耀於
熈明矧其產甸服翔辟雝尤
耿光所首被者哉臣以爲必有
卓犖魁奇如詩所稱吉人者
生其間而無從覿之也今有
司修比士之典論民秀以登
天府而臣猥承
上命獲叨斯役以自效於以人事
君之義臣之幸也受
命以來夙夜怔營手披目校蓋
庶幾一遇焉而觀諸生所爲
文言人人殊大都沉浸經術
alt_text:
聖天子復出挾墳策者流印〔臣〕伏
跡遜亦莫不滌志砥行蘄自
燿於
熈明矧其產甸服翔辟廱尤
耿光所首被者哉〔臣〕以爲必有
卓犖魁奇如詩所稱吉人者
生其間而無從覯之也今有
===
司修比士之典論民秀以登
天府而〔臣〕猥承
上命櫌叨斯役以自效於以人事
君之義〔臣〕之幸也受
命以来夙夜怔營手披目校盖
庶幾一遇焉而觀諸生所爲
文言人人殊大都沉浸經術
punctuated: 聖天子復出。挾墳策者流，即隱伏疏逖，亦莫不滌志砥行，蘄自耀於熈明，矧其產甸服、翔辟雝，尤耿光所首被者哉！臣以爲必有卓犖魁奇如《詩》所稱吉人者生其間，而無從覿之也。今有司修比士之典，論民秀以登天府，而臣猥承上命，獲叨斯役，以自效於以人事君之義，臣之幸也。受命以來，夙夜怔營，手披目校，蓋庶幾一遇焉。而觀諸生所爲文，言人人殊，大都沉浸經術，
translation_en: …a sage Son of Heaven has appeared once more. Even those who carry the ancient texts and bamboo slips in secluded or distant places without exception cleanse their aspirations and whet their conduct, hoping to distinguish themselves in an era of resplendent enlightenment—how much more so those born in the Capital Domain or soaring in the Imperial University, who are the very first to be bathed in His glorious light! Your servant believed that there must be preeminent and extraordinary talents among them, such as the "worthy men" praised in the Classic of Poetry (Shi), though I had no way to see them for myself. Now the authorities are conducting the statutory ceremony for selecting scholars, evaluating the finest of the populace to register them in the Imperial Treasury. Unworthy as I am, your servant has received the Emperor's command and been favored with this commission, whereby I may exert myself in the duty of serving my ruler by recommending men of talent; this is your servant's great fortune. Since receiving the command, I have been in anxious awe day and night, turning pages by hand and collating by eye, hoping that I might perchance encounter such men. Examining the essays composed by the candidates, although each expresses himself differently, in general they are deeply immersed in classical learning…

title: 萬曆元年順天府鄉試錄
text:
不詭聖真至於上陳
帝猷下議吏道雝雝乎鳴世藉令
周士操簡而談不過矣則信
乎
王國之多士也自非雅化乘運
所挾持軼異宜不及此以故
臣之得之也津津喜乎其藝
===
不置誠重之矣雖然周之士
所以貴者直藝焉已哉謂其
馮翼孝德足以媚天子而及
庶人也乃今諸生者果皆若
而人舉乎脫有緣飾纖華希
徼榮利而臣第溺其詞亟採
之曰王國士王國士此與鳳

不置誠重之矣雖然周之士
所以貴者直藝焉已哉謂其
馮翼孝德足以媚天子而及
庶人也乃令諸生者果皆若
而人舉乎脫有緣飾纖華希
徼榮利而臣第溺其詞亟採
之曰王國士王國士此與鳳
punctuated: 不詭聖真。至於上陳帝猷，下議吏道，雝雝乎鳴世，藉令周士操簡而談，不過矣！則信乎王國之多士也。自非雅化乘運，所挾持軼異，宜不及此。以故臣之得之也，津津喜乎其藝不置，誠重之矣。雖然，周之士所以貴者，直藝焉已哉？謂其馮翼孝德，足以媚天子而及庶人也。乃今諸生者，果皆若而人舉乎？脫有緣飾纖華，希徼榮利，而臣第溺其詞，亟採之曰：「王國士！王國士！」此與鳳
translation_en: … and do not deviate from the true meaning of the sages. As for their setting forth imperial plans above and discussing the ways of officialdom below, how harmoniously they resound through the age! Even if the scholars of the Zhou held writing slips and discoursed, they could not surpass this. Truly, "the royal domain abounds with scholars"! Were it not that refined transformative teaching rides upon the dynasty's fortune, and that what they possess is extraordinarily outstanding, they surely could not have reached this level. For this reason, in obtaining them, I took unceasing delight in their literary skill, for I truly valued them. Even so, was that whereby the scholars of the Zhou were esteemed merely their literary skill? As it is said, they had "support, wings, filial piety, and virtue," sufficient to win the love of the Son of Heaven and extend to the common people. Now, are all of these candidates truly elected as men of this sort? Should there be any who merely adorn themselves with petty floridity in hopes of seeking glory and profit, while I simply indulge in their words and eagerly select them, crying, "Scholars of the royal domain! Scholars of the royal domain!"—how would this differ from regarding a… [an allusion completed on the next page: viewing a "zhaoming" beast as a phoenix]…

title: 萬曆元年順天府鄉試錄
text:
視昭明也何異哉臣於是有
餘懼矣嗚乎士方屈首治書
搤腕論天下事常憂抑塞不
一遇即遇又憂非時也今諸
生遭
世休隆且當
聖天子御曆之元即裒然爲舉首
===
斯其遇已奇矣乃猶不以周
士自表豎令舉者鰓鰓無巳
時豈諸生宿昔所自許意哉
夫旁羅雋髦出之奥渫
主上之惠也奮躡風雲感遇而論
報烈士之槩也諸生勉之矣
異日者通籍受事忼慨立勛

===
聖天子御曆之元即褎然為舉首
斯其遇已奇矣乃猶不以周
士自表豎令舉者緦緦無已
時豈諸生宿昔所自許意哉
夫旁羅雋髦出之輿𣿭
主上之惠也奮躕風雲感遇而論
報烈士之槩也諸生勉之矣
異日者通籍受事忼慨立勛
punctuated: 視昭明也何異哉？臣於是有餘懼矣。嗚乎！士方屈首治書，搤腕論天下事，常憂抑塞不一遇；即遇，又憂非時也。今諸生遭世休隆，且當聖天子御曆之元，即裒然爲舉首，斯其遇已奇矣。乃猶不以周士自表豎，令舉者鰓鰓無巳時，豈諸生宿昔所自許意哉？夫旁羅雋髦，出之奥渫，主上之惠也；奮躡風雲，感遇而論報，烈士之槩也。諸生勉之矣！異日者通籍受事，忼慨立勛
translation_en:
…regarding an owl as a phoenix? Because of this, your servant is left with lingering dread.

Alas! When scholars bow their heads to study the books and clasp their wrists in earnest discussion of the affairs of the realm, they constantly worry about being thwarted and never once finding recognition; and even if they do find recognition, they worry that the times are not right. Now these students have encountered an age of flourishing prosperity, and moreover, in the very first year of the Sacred Son of Heaven's reign, they have stood out at the head of the list of provincial graduates—how extraordinary is the recognition they have met with! Yet if they still do not distinguish themselves after the manner of the scholars of Zhou, causing those who recommended them to remain endlessly anxious, could this be what the students themselves aspired to in days past?

To cast a wide net for outstanding talents and draw them up from obscurity and mire is the grace of the Sovereign; to bound upward upon wind and clouds, moved by such recognition to think of repayment, is the spirit of a gallant scholar. Exert yourselves, students! In days to come, when your names are entered on the official registers and you take up your charges, spiritedly establishing meritorious…

title: 萬曆元年順天府鄉試錄
text:
節直與馮翼孝德方駕而驅
將必有遂歌之臣續卷阿餘
響攄之亡窮則豈獨
聖世之光而諸生亦永有聞哉
左春坊左中允兼翰林院編
修陳經邦謹序

節，直與馮翼孝德方駕而驅，將必有遂歌之臣，續《卷阿》餘響，攄之亡窮。則豈獨聖世之光，而諸生亦永有聞哉！
左春坊左中允兼翰林院編修陳經邦謹序。
translation_en:
… integrity, driving side by side with the supportive and filial men of virtue of antiquity. Then there will surely be ministers who compose odes in response, continuing the lingering echoes of the "Juan'e" (On the Mound) ode and extending them endlessly. Would this not only be the glory of our sacred age, but also bring everlasting renown to the candidates!
Respectfully prefaced by Chen Jingbang 陳經邦, Left Companion in the Left Secretariat of the Heir Apparent and concurrently Junior Compiler in the Hanlin Academy.
